host_scope: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU / sm_89 / WSL2 only

selection_observations_disclosed_before_.sdpa_allclose_trials: 1/39 for each SDPA path at atol=0.03125, rtol=0.02
selection_observations_disclosed_before_.interpretation: The custom candidate must preserve the eager BF16-matmul plus FP32-softmax contract; native SDPA cannot be used as the correctness baseline or deployment shortcut.

formal_objective.primary: Test whether a GQA-aware decode attention implementation that avoids physical KV 2-to-8 replication can beat the best correctness-eligible existing baseline while matching eager semantics.
formal_objective.deployment: Only after isolated gates, prove exact greedy-token equivalence on all frozen tapes with an output-attentions-false dispatch and unchanged cache/state.
non_objectives: changing q/k/v projection, rotary embedding, or KV cache update semantics
loosening correctness to admit the observed SDPA numerical path
tuning after formal holdout or Day-1 results

semantic_contract.operation: For BF16 Q[1,8,1,D], K/V[1,2,K,D], repeat each KV head across four adjacent query heads; compute BF16 QK matmul with scale 1.0, add BF16 mask[1,1,1,K], apply softmax in FP32 then cast probabilities to BF16, compute BF16-probability x BF16-V matmul, and return contiguous BF16 [1,1,8,D].
semantic_contract.reference: transformers Gemma4 eager_attention_forward from the frozen source identity
semantic_contract.mask_contract: contiguous BF16 [1,1,1,K]; finite additive values or BF16 minimum are supported
semantic_contract.accumulation: QK and PV reductions accumulate FP32; probabilities round to BF16 between softmax and PV to match eager

candidate_design.algorithm: Three Triton stages: tiled GQA-aware QK directly against two KV heads into FP32 score workspace; row-wise FP32 softmax into BF16 probability workspace; tiled PV directly against two KV heads into contiguous BF16 output.
avoids: physical KV repeat from 2 to 8 heads
changes to projections, rotary embedding, cache tensors, Parameters, or state_dict
candidate_design.workspace: FP32 scores [8,K] plus BF16 probabilities [8,K]; maximum at K=7359 is below 0.34 MiB.
candidate_design.tuning_policy: Only the frozen configurations may be selected. Development smoke may use the already-observed selection seeds. Before formal correctness, lock the candidate source SHA and do not edit it again in this attempt.

required: contiguous BF16 Q[1,8,1,D], K/V[1,2,K,D], and mask[1,1,1,K] on one device
D is 256 with K=512 or D is 512 with 807<=K<=7359
dispatch_contract.fallback: Any miss invokes the frozen transformers eager_attention_forward unchanged.
dispatch_contract.source_side_effects: Q, K, V, mask, KV cache, module Parameters, and state_dict must remain unchanged.

all_length_cases.distribution: unit_normal FP32 generated then cast BF16

mask_cases: first element set to BF16 minimum
last element set to BF16 minimum
hard_assertions: candidate output is allclose to frozen transformers eager output
GQA head mapping microcase proves query heads 0..3 consume KV head 0 and 4..7 consume KV head 1
all source tensors remain byte-identical with unchanged data_ptr and version
fallback is exact for every rejected condition
only frozen autotune choices are used
formal_correctness_protocol.failure_rule: Any locked-candidate correctness failure closes this K3 attempt; do not tune against revealed holdouts.

baselines.compile_eager: torch.compile(fullgraph=true, mode=reduce-overhead, dynamic=false) around the same output-only eager path.
baselines.best_baseline_rule: Per case, min(current_eager_p50_us, compile_eager_p50_us). SDPA is excluded because the frozen selection probe found it correctness-ineligible.

analytic_bytes.tier: Tier-A compulsory unique bytes for output_attentions=false
analytic_bytes.formula: BF16 Q + BF16 K + BF16 V + BF16 mask + BF16 output
analytic_bytes.tier_b_override: After two-day isolated positive gate, ncu dram__bytes.sum overrides Tier-A when absolute difference exceeds 15%.

measurement_protocol.precondition: formal correctness receipt PASS and locked candidate SHA unchanged
measurement_protocol.interleave: three-way rotation by repetition index within each of 13 frozen cases

bounded_continuation_gate.day1_positive_definition: invocation-weighted candidate speedup versus per-case best baseline >=1.05 and neither sliding nor full family speedup is below 0.95
bounded_continuation_gate.if_correctness_fails: Close this K3 attempt and retain all evidence.
bounded_continuation_gate.if_day1_is_not_positive: Close K3 without Day-2, ncu, or reconnection.
bounded_continuation_gate.if_day1_is_positive: Run the unchanged second valid calendar day before ncu or reconnection.

reconnection_protocol.precondition: correctness PASS, two-day isolated positive consistency PASS, and ncu complete
reconnection_protocol.dispatch: torch.library output-only custom op inside the current output_attentions=false attention path; all misses use transformers eager
hard_gates: exact greedy token IDs for every request
343 NF4 modules, all Parameters, state_dict hashes, and KV cache tensors remain structurally unchanged
candidate count is exactly 42 per generated token only when every dispatch condition holds

execution_order: Freeze this protocol and receipt before candidate implementation.
Implement and debug only on already-observed selection inputs.
Lock candidate source SHA before revealing formal holdout inputs to the candidate.
Only on correctness PASS run Day-1 and apply the bounded continuation gate.
